caption:
Your invoices get an aging report. Your leads don't.

Every open lead sits in one of four buckets, sorted by time since first contact: 0–5 minutes, 5–60 minutes, 1–24 hours, and 24-plus.

Each bucket needs a different move.

Bucket one gets an instant automated touch. Bucket two gets a live callback. Bucket three gets a channel switch. Bucket four gets reactivation, not another sales pitch.

Respond inside 5 minutes and you're playing a different game. Most shops don't, and most CRMs won't flag it when they miss the window.

Pull your last 20 leads this week. Timestamp them. Sort them into the four buckets. Count what's sitting in bucket four.

DM TOOLS

#SpeedToLead #ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #CRM #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels currently lead saves and depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed time-based aging-bucket framework (borrowed from receivables logic) distinct from every prior self-score, diagnostic, triage, ladder, and ownership model already covered.
